name: BRISCOLONE
description: Briscolone is a two-player trick-taking card game without a trump suit. Players follow suit when possible and use Briscola-style point values to win tricks and accumulate a running total over several deals.

content.text: Briscolone is a two-player trick-taking card game without a trump suit. Players follow suit when possible and use Briscola-style point values to win tricks and accumulate a running total over several deals.

Country/Region of Origin: Italy
Time Period: Early 20th century
Historical Development: Briscolone evolved as a larger two-player variant of the Italian point-trick game Briscola, using the same card values but dealing more cards and removing the trump suit.
Cultural Significance: Played as a casual head-to-head game and described in modern Italian card-game collections.

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 2
Optimal Players: 2
Partnerships: Not used; Briscolone is played head-to-head.

Type: Standard 52-card deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Not included
